method: Node v24.15.0. Full compiled and N=1000 reference each have three alternating fresh-process pairs per host. Same-source full compiled, full reference, and unchanged Euler459 compatibility each have one pair per host. Before uses built f8ef186d. Same-source uses new461 source both sides; compat459 uses unchanged459 source both sides. Parse/analysis/execution included, startup excluded, process-lifetime peak RSS. Foreign Node jobs monitored before/every second; Intel >=98% idle and zero active swap before samples. Matching accepted prefixes resume; every accepted final sample retained.

verification.smallOracle: Exhaustive sorted quadruples, 60-digit exponentials and independently computed Machin pi at twelve small bounds
verification.typeScript: source and tests passed on Mac

limitations: The same-source Mac compiler/runtime control increases RSS; do not claim universal compiler memory savings.
Only full-compiled and small-reference are three-pair medians. Other rows are one-pair diagnostic controls.
The floating screen retains the original 40-digit final comparison, but is not an arbitrary-precision certificate for every larger N.
Default chunk size changes from 4000000 to 262144; public C option retained. Exploratory 1m/262144 chunk comparisons were not mixed into the final series.
Exploratory original Mac runs used less RSS with identical work counts, showing GC sensitivity. All final ranges retained.
A preliminary Mac compat459 sample contaminated by foreign Node PID17682 was discarded; all 16 accepted461 Mac samples remained intact, and compat459 was repeated after that process exited.
Fresh-array function-prefix publication pruning is an unmeasured follow-up, not implemented here.
